description: This Java class implements a service for reading self-beneficiary data related to transfer platform services in the Fineract project. It includes methods to retrieve all beneficiaries, retrieve account templates, and get transfer limits, with internal mappers for SQL result sets.

classes.name: SelfBeneficiariesTPTReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of service to read self-beneficiary transfer platform data, including methods to retrieve beneficiaries, account templates, and transfer limits.

classes.name: BeneficiaryMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping SQL result set to SelfBeneficiariesTPTData objects.

classes.name: AccountTemplateMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping SQL result set to SelfAccountTemplateData objects.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves all self-beneficiaries for the authenticated user.

methods.name: retrieveTPTSelfAccountTemplateData
methods.description: Retrieves account template data for a given user.

methods.name: getTransferLimit
methods.description: Fetches the transfer limit for a specific user, account, and account type.
